meta.title: A% of B is B% of A
meta.summary: SAMPLE 14% of 50: swap to 50% of 14 instead of grinding 0.14.

success.message:
Session complete. Pick the percent that is a nice chunk (50, 25, 10).

SAMPLE: 14% of 50=7, 8% of 25=2.

start.message:
SAMPLE: 14% of 50. Both numbers are awkward if you pick the wrong side.

What is the move?

choices.label: Swap: 50% of 14 is the same product

wrong_start_point.message:
You can, but the swap is the taught shortcut. 50% of 14 is a half.

Return to the swap.

wrong_start_onepct.message:
That works slowly and ignores the easy half. Swap first when one side is 50, 25, or 10.

Return to the swap.

wrong_half_fourteen.message:
50% is half, not identity. Half of 14 is 7.

Revisit the half.

wrong_half_70.message:
×5 would be 500%. Half of 14 is 7.

Revisit the half.

check.message:
Same swap: 8% of 25.

Which side is easier?

choices.label: Stay on 8% of 25 and grind it

wrong_check_eight_of_25.message:
25% of 8 is a quarter of 8. That is the easier half.

Try the check again.

wrong_check_swap_wrong.message:
You swapped only one number. A% of B = B% of A, so 8% of 25 = 25% of 8.

Try the check again.
